market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $85 Week of May 4 2026?

assessment.reasoning: WTI active month is ~$92-96 on May 7. Question requires WTI 1-min low at or below $85 during week of May 4 — only May 7-8 trading days remain. Need ~7-12% drop in 1-2 days. Recent action shows oil falling on Iran de-escalation but $85 is still a steep move from $92+. Very unlikely.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Black-swan supply/demand shock in 1-2 days could trigger waterfall, but unlikely.
